text: Compass Minerals International, Inc. (NYSE: CMP) is a US-listed salt and plant-nutrition miner. Its 5% stockholders table lists Koch Industries, Inc. at 16.81% (7,034,609 shares); the Schedule 13D/A reports that beneficial owner subsidiaries of the parent holding company are KM&T Investment Holdings, LLC, Koch Minerals & Trading, LLC and Koch Solutions, LLC.
short: Compass Minerals International, Inc. (NYSE: CMP); Koch Industries holds 16.81%.
